note: Both sets share the same core claims, including the segment dimensions and the 5'-2 1/2" and 8'-0" dimensions, but they differ in a few claims. Set A states the deck module scale twice (duplicate) and gives the scaffold footing only a weak 'presence | installed' claim, while Set B correctly extracts its type as ADJUSTABLE and keeps the needed 'relative to Grade Level' condition on the First Floor 2'-4" elevation. Set B's only real blemishes are a stray space in the scale value and a truncated quote for the scaffold footing claim.
remarks: Both sets bind the 1'-4 3/4" / 1'-4" / 1'-3 1/4" segment dimensions to 'RAILING ATTACHMENT', but on the page these segments belong to the 4'-0" dimension string of the A1 TYP. DECK MODULE plan; the shared 'deck connection | spacing | 1'-4 3/4" ... center to center' claim is likewise unsupported as stated. The 'scaffold footing | connection | frame' claim in both sets is vague about what connection is meant.
